proposed.subject: REC-118: interview pack for the operations shortlist
proposed.training_context: Recruitment brief REC-118: operations-shortlist panel. Agency contact: Mara Chen at wrenfield-search.example. Delivery record: three PDF interview packs in an encrypted ZIP; archive password exchanged on the scheduled phone call. Panel scores are collected in the internal recruitment record.
proposed.explanation: The independent recruitment brief establishes the sender, delivery format, expected PDF contents, password channel and response workflow before this message arrives. The email and visible attachment preview match those details and request no additional viewer, account authorization or change of destination. This is legitimate within the supplied evidence, despite the encrypted external attachment. Encryption, a ZIP extension, a matching sender or the absence of an install request would not alone establish safety. Use the organization's normal file-handling controls and stop if the actual contents or opening behavior differ; a preview cannot guarantee that real files are harmless. The simulated archive contains no downloadable files.
learning_objectives: Evaluate an external archive against independently established delivery expectations.
Distinguish confidentiality measures from evidence of authenticity or file safety.
Check expected contents and preserve the existing response workflow without treating every encrypted attachment as phishing.
proposed.email_body:
Panel members,

The operations shortlist is ready for the panel review under REC-118. I have included the three interview packs in the encrypted archive, using the password from our scheduled call.

[[attachment:REC-118_interview_packs.zip|Contents preview: Candidate-A.pdf, Candidate-B.pdf, Candidate-C.pdf]]

Please extract the PDFs and review them before the panel discussion. The archive contains the candidate packs only; scoring remains in the internal recruitment record so that each interviewer can complete an independent assessment.

If the password does not open the archive, contact me using the details already recorded in the recruitment brief and I will arrange another delivery.

Kind regards,
Mara Chen
Wrenfield Search
